description: Machine-readable API changelog and compatibility policy for FateCat developer platform baseline.

compatibilityPolicy.breakingChangePolicy: Breaking changes require a changelog entry, migration note, compatibility window and release gate evidence before public release.
compatibilityPolicy.deprecationPolicy: Deprecated paths or fields must remain discoverable with replacement guidance until their removal window closes.
compatibilityPolicy.versioning: HTTP paths currently use /api/v1 aliases and stable root aliases; future public releases must pin compatibility notes here.

entries.summary: Added local OpenAPI export, sandbox fixture, curl/Python/Node/Agent examples and developer docs smoke baseline.
Added developer platform machine contract, SDK/package baseline, sandbox token contract, API changelog and developer platform gate.
Added local developer portal baseline, SDK release-readiness manifest, fixed sandbox output snapshots and developer portal gate.
Added local sandbox access gateway baseline for scoped capability execution, rate-limit evidence and redacted audit events without claiming a public token issuer.

limitations: This changelog is a local baseline and does not prove an external developer portal is live.
This changelog does not prove a published SDK package exists.
This changelog does not store production credentials or user payloads.
